result:
The API died because the disk filled up: a `report-export` job wrote about 20 GB of CSVs to `/var/lib/stockroom` in eight minutes, Postgres ran out of space, and the api process exited and never came back.

One thing to check first: the timestamps in `logs/service.log` are all 2026-03-09 (02:00–05:29), not last night. Either this is an old or sample log, or the clock on that host is wrong, so confirm it's the incident you mean.

**Timeline**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 03:05:00 | `job=report-export` starts writing `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/part-*.csv`, 512 MB each, one every 12 s |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%` |
| 03:12:48 | Last export file written (40 files, about 20 GB in total) |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%` |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool` |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` |
| 03:16:00 onwards | `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes, 67 times, through 05:28:00 |

**What the log shows**

- **No recovery:** the last successful api request is at 03:13:51, and there is no api line of any kind after the FATAL. The api was still down when the log ends at 05:29:57, so the outage lasted at least 2 h 15 min.
- **No restart attempts:** `docker-compose.yml` sets `restart: unless-stopped` on api, yet the log has no restart or startup lines. I can't tell from this file whether it wasn't restarted or was crash-looping silently.
- **Other services:** `web` and `proxy` kept returning 200 for their own requests throughout.
- **Unrelated noise:** the `cache: slow command` warnings (100–149 ms, every 5 minutes or so) run from 02:00 to the end of the log, at the same rate before and after the crash.
- **Before the job:** there were no errors or disk warnings before the export started; api latencies were normal (6–44 ms) right up to the crash.

**What the log doesn't say**

- Why the export wrote so much; the job stops logging after 03:12:48 without a completion or error line.
- Whether the two disk warnings alerted anyone. There were only two, and the second came 30 seconds before the database failed.

I haven't changed anything. The next step would be to find what launches `report-export` (my search of `scripts/` and `app/` for it returned nothing) and check `scripts/disk_alert.py` to see why the warnings didn't page anyone.
